subject: maths
question: The average age of P, Q and R is 19 years and that of P and Q is 20 years. R's present age is:
solution:
Given:

Average age of P, Q, and R = 19 years.

The average age of P and Q together = 20 years

Formula:

Average = sum of data/number of data

Calculations:

⇒ (P + Q + R)/3 = 19

⇒ P + Q + R = 57

The total age of P and Q together = 2 × 20

⇒ 40

⇒ 40 + R = 57

⇒ R = 17 years

∴ R’s present age is 17 years.
